edg.title: Cloudflare protection
edg.sub: The shop's own rules at Cloudflare, in front of the server. Cloudflare's DDoS protection is always on; these rules add to it. Every rule covers only the shop's addresses.

kpi.mockFoot: Nothing is sent until the token is in Keys & connections
kpi.liveFoot: Rules go to your Cloudflare zone

edg.ddos: Cloudflare's DDoS protection is always on for the whole zone and needs nothing here. Customers are never shown a challenge or a waiting page.

hosts.staging: Practising with the staging address: {list}. With the Cloudflare token, the host names of the connection are used.
hosts.none: No address yet, so no rule can be made: add the shop's host names in Keys & connections → Cloudflare.

rule.extas-shield: Security level, browser check and SSL
rule.extas-admin: Check on the admin sign-in page

does.extas-shield: Sets the security level and the browser check for the shop's addresses, and SSL Full (strict) to the server.
does.extas-probes: Refuses addresses robots try on every site (like /wp-login.php). The shop has none of them.
does.extas-admin: Cloudflare checks the visitor on the admin sign-in page only. Never on the shop.
does.extas-admin-login: Above the limit, Cloudflare refuses that address for 10 seconds.

st.extra: Not in the plan any more

send.d: Writes the saved plan's rules to Cloudflare. Only the shop's own rules change; every other rule in the zone stays as it is.

err.NO_HOST: There is no shop address yet: add the host names in Keys & connections → Cloudflare.
err.SEND_FAILED: Cloudflare did not take the rules. Check the token's rights in Keys & connections, then try again.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to send these rules.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not work. Please try again.

card.d: Saved here first; nothing changes at Cloudflare until you press "Send to Cloudflare".
card.securityLevelHelp: How strict Cloudflare is with doubtful visitors. "I'm under attack" is never offered: it shows every customer a waiting page.
card.browserCheckHelp: Refuses requests with a forged or missing browser header. A real customer never notices.
card.sslStrictHelp: Cloudflare checks the server's Origin certificate on every request.
card.probePaths: Addresses to refuse (beginnings, separated by commas)
card.probePathsHelp: Each starts with /. The shop never uses them.
card.adminChallenge: Check visitors on the admin sign-in page
card.adminChallengeHelp: Off by default. Only the admin sign-in page, never the shop.
card.adminLoginPer10s: Admin sign-in tries per 10 seconds from one address (0 = off)
card.adminLoginPer10sHelp: Above this, Cloudflare refuses that address for 10 seconds. Only the owner can change it.

err.STALE: Someone else changed this plan; it shows their values now.
err.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can change the sign-in limit.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to change this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.

edg.saved: Saved. Press "Send to Cloudflare" to use it.
edg.readOnly: You can see the plan; changing it needs the settings permission.
